game.name: Test Drive Unlimited 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Test Drive Unlimited 2 for Xbox 360 is a massively multiplayer racing game set in a persistent universe that allows players to compete, cooperate and share their creations online. The game offers the chance to drive the world's most beautiful cars, with a damage system, in open environments with weather effects and a day/night cycle.
